analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date, adds a sentence that each CI provider test shard is routed through its own lane (test-provider-K, linked to build.md#ci-runner-routing), and extends the description of scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py to say it pins each routed job's lanes (one per provider shard, matching the matrix). The base-text units I examined (docs/developer/test.md lines 921-1847) show surrounding context only: App Attest dispatch tests, native serving qualification, release qualification, cluster checks and Flint validation. These sections were unchanged. The patch changes no code, workflow, secrets handling, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache storage or fan-helper behavior, and so affects none of the assets or trust boundaries in the model (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012, T-041 and the others). The runner-routing statement is documentation of CI configuration. Whether the routing script and workflows actually implement per-shard lanes is outside the supplied evidence, as are the workflows and scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py themselves. Any CI-trust implications would belong to a review of those files, not of this doc change. No threat-model update is needed for this PR.
